title: Control Flow
summary: Making decisions and repeating work - if and else, the conditional operator, switch, for loops in their three forms, while and do-while, break and continue, and labelled loops.

cards.q: What is the difference between `for...of` and `for...in`?
cards.a:
`for...of` gives the values of an array (any iterable); `for...in` gives object keys

Use `for...of` for arrays and strings; `for...in` is for object keys (on an array it gives the indexes as strings).

cards.q: What happens when a `switch` case has no `break` or `return`?
cards.a:
Execution falls through into the next case

Without break or return, execution carries on into the following case's code. That is handy for grouping cases and a bug when forgotten.

cards.q: How many times does the body of `do { } while (false);` run?
cards.a:
1

A do...while loop checks its condition after the body, so the body always runs at least once.
